title: Flyer translation check kit
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for a community center's agent kit that checks translated service flyers against the English source for dropped facts, changed numbers, dates and phone numbers, untranslated text and reading level, while a fluent community reviewer approves each language and staff decide what gets printed.
boundaries: Use only made-up, clearly marked test data.
Steps marked for a person never go to an agent.
Outputs stay surface_only in the requester's scope.
Importing the pack writes nothing and enqueues nothing.

nouns.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for a multilingual service flyer translation check agent kit

value.lets_workers: Check each translated service flyer against its English source: every fact present, numbers, dates, times and phone numbers matching exactly, words left in English, and sentences above the reading level. The agent lists questions for a fluent community reviewer, who approves each language; staff decide what gets printed and put up.
human_only: Decide what gets printed and posted.
rules: Use only made-up, clearly marked test data. Never put a real person's details into the kit, a test case or an output.
Steps marked for a person stay with people. The agent drafts or helps; it never decides about a person and never contacts anyone.
Tools are read-only. Anything that changes records outside the requester's scope is a person's step.

provenance_notes.note: The marketplace's example of this kit. It holds only the catalog's own fields and points at this pack's kit and need nouns by value digest, so the kit has one source.

One recorded example run of the kit on a desktop computer with made-up data: check, build and independent review with the marketplace's own pipeline, zero model calls. Not a hosted run or an evaluation.

nouns.title: Multilingual Service Flyer Translation Check Kit
nouns.category_reason: The agent's whole setup as one noun: its step map and pins to every part.

value.summary: Checks each translated service flyer against its English source for dropped facts, changed numbers, dates and phone numbers, untranslated text and reading level. A fluent community reviewer approves each language, and staff decide what gets printed and posted.
value.goal: Help a community center check translated service flyers against the English source for dropped facts, changed numbers and dates, untranslated text and reading level, while a fluent community reviewer approves each language and staff decide what gets printed and posted.
value.target_org: Community health and services center printing flyers in five languages

step_map.title: Compare facts across the source and each translation
step_map.guidance: List every fact in the English source, such as the service, hours, dates, address line, phone number, cost and who can use it, and check that each appears unchanged in each translation. Numbers, dates and phone numbers must match exactly.

step_map.title: Draft questions for the fluent reviewer
step_map.guidance: For each language, list the sentences where meaning may have shifted, words left in English and sentences above the target reading level, as questions for the fluent reviewer, not corrections.

step_map.title: Approve each translation (fluent community reviewer)
step_map.guidance: A fluent speaker from the community reads the whole flyer, answers the questions and approves or corrects the translation. Machine checks never replace this step.

step_map.title: Decide what gets printed and posted
step_map.guidance: Staff print and post only translations the fluent reviewer approved, and keep each approval with its flyer version.

nouns.title: Skill: check a translated flyer against its source

value.name: flyer-fact-checker
value.description: Compares a translated flyer with its English source for dropped or changed facts, exact numbers and dates, and untranslated text.
value.instructions: Work from the English source and the translation the center provides. Build a fact list from the source: service name, days, hours, dates, address line, phone number, cost and who can use the service. For each translation, mark each fact as matching, changed or missing; numbers, dates, times and phone numbers must match character for character after normal formatting for that language. List words left in English. Turn every problem into a question for the fluent reviewer. Never rewrite the translation yourself and never call a translation approved.
refuses: Rewriting a flyer in another language for printing
Printing, posting or sharing a flyer
Guessing a fact the source does not state

nouns.title: Made-up test cases for the flyer translation check kit

cases.scenario: All five translations carry every fact unchanged
cases.sample_input: MADE-UP: Flu clinic flyer in English with Spanish, Vietnamese, Arabic, Haitian Creole and Tagalog versions; the date 2026-11-12, the hours 9:00 to 13:00 and the phone line 555-0142 match in every version.

cases.scenario: A translated date and phone number differ from the source
cases.sample_input: MADE-UP: The Tagalog version shows 2026-11-21 instead of 2026-11-12 and the phone line 555-0124 instead of 555-0142.

nouns.title: A community center's need, in its own words
nouns.category_reason: A need in an organization's own plain words frames what the kit should do.

value.says: We need each translated flyer checked against the English version before we print it, so a wrong date or phone number never goes out again. A fluent person from the community approves every language.

nouns.title: Template: facts compared across a flyer's languages
nouns.category_reason: A fact comparison is a deterministic check run with a result per fact.

value.describes: every source fact checked in every translation as match, changed or missing, with words left in English
rules: A date, time, phone or cost fact matches only when its digits are identical to the source.

nouns.title: Template: questions for the fluent reviewer of one language
nouns.category_reason: Questions for the reviewer are candidate problems the fluent reviewer confirms or dismisses.

value.describes: questions for the fluent reviewer of one language, each quoting the source and the translation

questions.question: The source says 2026-11-12, and this version says 2026-11-21. Which date is right?

rules: Questions only, never corrections or approval.

nouns.title: Template: a person's record of a step that stays with people

value.describes: what a person did at a step that stays with people, without names or case details
